evidence.title: the organiser sees only what the participant chose to share, and a retraction removes it
evidence.assertion: The organiser report counts unshared feedback only as notShared with ratingCount 0 and no comments; once the participants share them the ratings and comments are counted without any participant name; withdrawing consent removes the figure again; a retraction hides the record, and retracting together with sharing is refused by the schema and by SQL (23514).

evidence.title: feedback and outcomes are written only by the registered participant, as consented revisions
evidence.assertion: Each other principal tried (alice, carol, dave, eve and an outsider) is refused with 42501 when writing feedback for the registered participant bob or reading his own records; a participant cannot revise another record or another kind of record (42501); a revision against a stale expected version is refused with 23514.
